nextSlice.objective: Pressure-test the explicit claimResults verifier-plugin contract on WAVE, PNG and legacy verify-stage adapters before changing production routing.

provenProperties: A common EvaluationRequest can represent production-v1 compatibility routes and registered standards-first verify routes without inventing one universal execution sequence.
A common EvidenceObservation envelope can round-trip legacy verify-stage results and family verification service results canonically without imposing one native verifier schema.
The envelope fails closed when common projections or native evidence drift.
Verification status and evidence completeness are independent axes.
A StandingDecision can be derived fail-closed from profile requiredEvidence plus explicit claimResults.
Native verifier aggregate PASS is insufficient for profile PASS when any required evidence key lacks an explicit claim result.
Trust status and release status remain independent of verification PASS.
rejectedShortcuts: infer claim satisfaction from verifier aggregate PASS
infer claim mapping by string similarity
treat standing.bindings keys as a universal requiredEvidence mapping
treat consumer acceptance standing as Artifact kernel standing
replace family-native result schemas with one universal Artifact AST
